behaviors.A2: Exact catalog material names/prefixes include bulk and bagged aggregates; reject polymeric sand, sand-colored pavers, roofing gravel stops, packaging, inactive/zero-quantity lines and PO/TO.

behaviors.S2: Persist at most one aggregate nightly run per Toronto date across concurrent workers, failure, interruption, and restart; retain ordinary manual resume for unfinished targets.
behaviors.S3: Freeze the selection filter and schedule date in the run; selection and resume never broaden into non-aggregate orders; successful aggregate runs never consume the broad nightly date.
behaviors.U1: Admin sees a dedicated form with enable, time, fixed scope, next run, last run/status; saving persists through the existing admin-only settings endpoint and reload.
behaviors.U2: Invalid times/flags rejected; unauthenticated and non-admin writes denied; history labels aggregate scope explicitly.
behaviors.I1: Existing packing-draft, local reopen, operational priority, frozen-target resume, manual reconciliation and response-sharing protections remain. No NetSuite financial writes added.
